notes.title: Update v1.014 - Last 15 missions deployed finally! - WIN only
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

it's been quite a ride last few months and I'm happy to announce that we managed to keep the promise and deliver last 15 missions before end of the year :)

This update contains:
- last 15 missions (those 5 stations at bottom row at Mission Control)
- 5 new achievemenets which go with each new station as part of this content
- leaderboards for all game modes for remaining 15 maps

IMPORTANT: those players who played through the whole content so far, to unlock new station and new missions you will have to win again mission 10-2 in Classic mode in order to progress forward.

For those who didn't come to the station #10 so far, once you get there the new station RX-78 should unlock once you clear missions 10-1, 10-2 and 10-3.

This update today is deployed for WIN only platform.
Update for Linux and Mac will be released tomorrow during the day.

Also one important thing to announce, the price point.
Since game is now complete in terms of content which was promissed ever since Early Access the price point of the game will change and it will go up for 30%. 

Price will change once Winter SALE (2016) ends. 

WHAT's NEXT?
Next updates should bring the game localized to various languages and potentially support for Steam controller and gamepad.

That's all for now people, stay cool, Happy Holiday Season and keep those stations safe by building solid defense!

All the best,
Vedran Klanac
Solar Division Commander

notes.title: Update v1.012 - Windows ONLY - crash reporting system
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

from time to time we get reports that game crashes on the launch or at some point and usually it's quite tedious to catch the bug without proper information.

I'm happy to announce that we have integrated crash reporting system in Solar Division.

In general if your game crashes, game will generate 3 files in the same folder where your main executable file is:

 OceanMedia-Crash-Instructions.txt

 OceanMedia-CrashReport.txt
 OceanMedia-CrashDump.dmp


First file on the list is obvious, describes what to do in this case.
Other two files is what we need and just simply email them to support@oceanmedia.hr and we'll take it from there.

This will help us a lot to improve the game and cure terminal bugs.

Vedran Klanac,
creator of Solar Division

notes.title: MAJOR Update - Version 1.009

Patch has been released today with following aspects of the game updated:


 MAJOR FEATURE - added difficulty levels for each level / when ENDLESS mode selected game will always play on NORMAL difficulty
 MAJOR FEATURE - for every mission, for each game mode except ENDLESS, and for each level of difficulty we added a badge next to mission preview image, in total there is 450 badges you can collect!!!
 feature - added button to bring up tutorial for Command Bridge screen
 feature - added tutorial for Command Bridge screen
 MAJOR ADJUSTMENT - rebalanced Shocker tower to slow down enemies a bit more and decreased damage a lot (to 1/3 what it was)
 MAJOR ADJUSTMENT - rebalanced Laser, Smart Laser, Double Laser towers, increased amount of damage they make

Based on these features which are introduced with this update, next logical step is to introduce number of new achievements which we were not able
to have up to this point.

All ideas for new achievements are welcome and feel free to start the discussion at Community Hub.

Thanks once again on all active feedback, we are making notes and working on improvements and bug fixes.

Both PC and Linux builds are updated.

Vedran Klanac, 
creator of Solar Division

notes.title: Update - Patch 0.3
notes.notes:
Patch has been released today with following aspects of the game updated:


 fix - inflicting damage issue when speed is changed from speed to fast and vice versa - we won't claim this is 100% but improvement is such that we don't see this to be an issue anymore, please report if this still feels wrong
 fix - rockets and missiles properly speed up and slow down when speed of the game is changed
 fix - enemies stop coming at some point - we found out a code which might have caused this and patched it - if this still happens to someone, please be kind and report the case
 fix - rebalanced Beacon element on mission 5-1 to have a bit more health - this was critical issue for having this mission very hard to solve as a victor
 fix - removed Power Station as a tower and its achievement - this tower is prepared for future use and right now it makes no sense, thanks to a user who noticed this
 fix - when tower is upgraded - damage for towers which fire continous laser beam Damage Per Second would be degraded
 fix - preview for enemy waves in ENDLESS mode was showing wrong hit points value
 fix - automatic position of window in windowed mode is now set to CENTER of the monitor
 feature - improved visuals for laser fires and Shocker tower
 feature - added particles every time enemy is hit and not destroyed yet
 feature - every enemy path is now rendered in different color
 fix - LINUX ONLY - WARNING - changed location of the save game to be queried by SDL_GetPrefPath -> most likely your new save game path is "home/.local/share/OceanMedia/SolarDivision"
 fix - adjusted description of the game at the store page, saying that this is tower defense game


Little note on version numbers. At the main menu, in lower right corner, you can see the version of the game.
Right now it is set as 1.003, where 1 means it is full release, while 003 means it is patch 0.3.
So when you start the game next time and if you notice different number than what you remember was before, that means an update was released and you
can always check at the game page description to see what's new.
I'm not sure if everyone knew that we are doing it this way and I wanted to communicate this so you can better understand the correlation between patch number and game version number.

Thanks once again on all active feedback, we are making notes and working on improvements and bug fixes.

Both PC and Linux builds are updated.

Vedran Klanac, 
creator of Solar Division

notes.title: Update - Full Release
notes.notes:
Today we have made full release of the game with following updates:


 30 missions
 6 different challenge modes
 Steam Achievements 
 180 Steam leaderboards
 tutorial
 towers and aliens encyclopedia
 rebalanced first 10 levels


Additional 15 missions will be released in following weeks, where every week we expect to release 3 new missions.
These missions will be released as regular updates, not as DLC and players won't be charged any money for that content.
This was our promise during Early Access and we will keep it.

Because we decided to rebalance first 10 levels, number of score boards had to be reset.

I would like to express special thanks to user "The Alpha And Omega" on great discussion and suggestions on improving the game.
Dude, you ended up in game credits and whole ZeroBit Games team appreciate your contribution.

There are couple of other polish and updates that we plan in the near future, such as:

 localization to other languages (DE, IT, ES, FR, RU, HR)
 gamepad and Steam controller support
 we are exploring idea to release level editor - this is still under question mark


Vedran Klanac, 
creator of Solar Division

Hi everyone,

this is special update as it brings couple of new features which, we hope, will create new experience for all the players.

Check point system is now integrated, which means that during level gameplay you will notice a progress bar with check points.
Once check point is saved there is visual and audio notification. In lower right corner of the grid, you will notice small widget saying "CHECK POINT SAVED!".

If you want to restore previously saved check point, you will do that using BACKSPACE key on the keyboard. Once check point is restored, you will see notification about it.

Another feature which is added in today's update are voice overs for, what we call, Battle Assistant. Various actions performed are now accompanied with voice over. You can disable Battle Assistant under the Options menu.

Because of various changes that had to be done to save game file, we have increased the version of save game file, which means that your current save game can not be used anymore and fresh start is required.

This update is released both for Windows and Linux version.

This is it for now, and this is most likely last update before full release.

We are almost done with design of remaining missions and full release of the game is expected within next following weeks.

One thing to have in mind is, considering the amount of new content and other improvements which are and will be added, price for full release will go up. So if you have friends who like space themed tower defense game, please spread the word because now is good opportunity to get the game.

Vedran Klanac,
Solar Division Commander

notes.title: Update #8 - Finalized Early Access content
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

with today's release we have finalized the content which was planned for Early Access which consists of 7 space stations and 21 missions in total.

From this point on, we will be focused on following aspects:

 rebalancing certain towers, their prices and other parameters might change
 integrating check point system, temporary save points during single level, such system is well known to those who played Defense Grid
 improving the art for the towers
 designing new missions with new sets of art
 producing cut scenes and implementing them in the game


Remaining 24 missions will be released when we leave Early Access and release full version of the game.

Vedran Klanac, 
creator of Solar Division

notes.title: Update #4 - minor fixes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

two minor fixes were made:

 rendering of purple circle, showing range is in sync if UPGRADE button is disabled
 fix for not unlocking next mission in case previous mission was solved


Also, additional note about mission unlocking mechanism.

First mission unlocks 2nd mission while 2nd mission unlocks 3rd mission on current station AND 1st mission on next station. 

Vedran Klanac,
creator of Solar Division

notes.title: Update #3 - new missions, key bindings, tower range adjustments
notes.notes:
In today's update following changes have been made to the game:


 adjusted default range for all the towers, it is increased a bit
 mission #1 - adjusted path for enemies to curve better around the rocks and fits better into range of available towers
 added preview for tower range AFTER upgrade if you roll-over the UPGRADE button for the selected tower
 couple of functions got its key bindings - SHOW/HIDE PATH [P], change SPEED [S], NEXT WAVE [SPACEBAR]
 added 3 new missions for Sofia station, that's 4th station


Next update is planned for next week.

Vedran Klanac, 
creator of Solar Division

notes.title: Update #2 - path visibility, speed control, after upgrade info added
notes.notes:
In today's update following changes have been made to the game:


 added button to control path visibility - it's right below tower buttons on user interface
 added button to control speed of the enemies - it's middle one below tower buttons -> you can change speed between NORMAL and FAST
 added button to control start of the NEXT WAVE, it's the rightmost one, right below tower buttons
 first wave on the level now starts when FIRST tower is placed on the grid -> there is a message on the Info panel in the lower right corner of the screen
 added arrows at the beginning for each enemy path showing where exactly enemies will enter the area
 added info to Tower info panel showing how will damage and range look like "after upgrade"
 increased range for rocket launcher tower Triton to 180m 
 shocker tower adjusted to slow down the target a bit more


I would also like to announce Linux version to be released during December 2015, no exact date yet.

Next update is planned for Tuesday, Dec 8th 2015, with more new content coming.

Vedran Klanac, 
creator of Solar Division
